intro: Who Builds It, detail 1 of 3, round 2. The label becomes Founder and the line a plain fact in the third person, the way Herbert AI speaks everywhere else on the page. The link stays.

lists.name: Today
rows: I’m Will Herbert. I build every system myself, in Adelaide, and you deal with me from the audit to the day it goes live.
lists.note: First person under “Who Builds It”: reads like a sales intro.

lists.name: 1. Said flat, at today’s size
rows: Herbert AI is Will Herbert, in Adelaide. He builds every system, and you deal with him from the audit to the day it goes live.
lists.note: The same fact, third person, the label Founder. Large, so it still carries the section on its own. Recommended.

lists.name: 2. Said flat, quieter
rows: Herbert AI is Will Herbert, in Adelaide. He builds every system, and you deal with him from the audit to the day it goes live.
lists.note: The same words at body size in grey, like a note at the foot of a page. Calmest; the section reads as a credit more than a statement.
